lines.en: Which cup is better, red or blue?
lines.ko: 빨간 컵과 파란 컵 중에 어느 게 더 좋아요?

lines.en: The blue one is good. It is bigger.
Do they look the same to you?
No, they are different. The red one is thin.
A thin cup broke last week.
That was bad. The blue one is better.
lines.ko: 그건 안 좋았죠. 파란 게 더 좋아요.

lines.en: Is it more expensive than the red one?
A little. But it is fine.
Good. I will take the blue one.
Most people like blue. Good pick!
lines.ko: 대부분 사람들이 파란색을 좋아해요. 잘 골랐어요!

lines.en: Hello. Which tea is good for the evening?
This one is better than the green tea.
Is it the same price?
No, it is a little different. This one costs more.
lines.ko: 아니요, 조금 달라요. 이게 더 비싸요.

lines.en: Last time I bought the green tea. It was fine.
This is our best tea. Most people love it.
lines.ko: 이건 저희 최고의 차예요. 대부분 사람들이 좋아해요.

lines.en: Is it bad for sleep?
No. It is good for sleep. Try it tonight.
lines.ko: 아니요. 잠에 좋아요. 오늘 밤에 마셔 봐요.

lines.en: Good. I will take this one. Thank you.
You are welcome. You will sleep well tonight.
lines.ko: 천만에요. 오늘 밤 잘 주무실 거예요.
